name: Stage 24: Svalboviken to Lundsjön
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 24, Svalboviken to Lundsjön.
utilities: Official area: Eskilstunas kommun, Katrineholms kommun.

This is a long, service-sparse forest stage. Svalboviken has official parking at/near the start, and Lundsjön has parking described north of the endpoint in a former gravel pit, but neither trailhead has verified toilets, shops, restaurants, or potable taps.

Public transport is not trailhead-convenient. Nearby rural stops such as Knektbacken, Ramsta, Trekanten/Bie, Flodafors, or Bie require multi-kilometre road walks and current Sörmlandstrafiken verification; do not assume weekend or school-holiday service.
No on-stage toilet was verified. The next confirmed trail toilet is on stage 25 at Myrgryten, about 3.5 km after Lundsjön.

On-route overnight options are basic and limited: Kolarkoja has two sleeping places and Gruvtorpet is an open hut officially listed with four sleeping places. Do not expect bins, firewood, or indoor services.
waterSources: The only official on-stage water point is the spring about 2-2.5 km south of Svalboviken, and official text marks its quality as uncertain. OSM tags it as a spring/drinking-water point, but the app should keep the official treat/filter warning.

Svalbosjön/Svalboviken, Tryningen/Trynningen, and Lundsjön can be surface-water fallback points only. Hiker reports mention easier pier access at Svalbosjön and Lundsjön, while Tryningen shoreline access can be vegetated; treat/filter/boil all lake water.
Carry enough water for the full 16.5 km in warm weather unless prepared to filter uncertain natural sources.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 16.5 km; Naturkartan describes about 17 km but its GPX measures about 16.29 km, matching OSM relation 3925407 at about 16.29 km. OSM's distance=15 km tag is stale; keep official 16.5 km for display.

Draw Stage 24 as the directed Svalboviken-Lundsjön mainline. At Svalboviken it forms a three-way junction with Stage 23 and 24:3; at Lundsjön it hands off to Stage 25, whose OSM geometry may need reversing when chaining onward.

Official page showed no formal fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass, but a June 2025 official-page comment reports clear-cuts, young growth, bark-beetle damage, overgrown/narrow tread, obscured orange markings after forestry work, confusing orange forestry paint, wet/muddy sections, and wild-boar-disturbed ground.

Route character is a long, lonely forest stage with a tough initial climb to Tyckenhed, Eskilstuna municipality's high point, then managed forest, Tryningen, mining/charcoal-history remains, Gruvtorpet, a limited Lundsjön viewpoint, and a possible cattle pasture near Lundsjön.

No designated campsite was verified. Practical tenting is limited by hilly/vegetated terrain; recent comments describe Tryningen/Trynningen as one of the better areas, while older reports mention few flat spots and one improvised forest-road turnaround. Use ordinary allemansrätten care and avoid farmland, homes, sensitive ground, and grazing animals.

No stage-specific nature-reserve rule overlap was confirmed for the normal corridor. Nearby Kokärret reserve/Natura 2000 wetland is very wet, has no trails, parking or visitor facilities, and should not be used as an access/camping/service assumption.

Fireplaces are not strongly verified on stage 24 except reported hut/rest contexts. Use only clearly established safe fire/grill places if present, bring no expectation of supplied wood, never cut live/dead trees, and check current fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Svalboviken stage start and parking
facilities.description: Official stage start with good parking described by Sörmlandsleden. OSM did not confirm a formal mapped parking object, so verify signs and overnight rules locally.

facilities.name: Svalbovikens badplats
facilities.description: Nearby bathing/access context by Svalbosjön. Surface water only; not a potable refill. Some hikers have parked near the beach, but use official/local parking signs.

facilities.name: Knektbacken rural bus context
facilities.description: Nearest mapped rural bus context found east/southeast of Svalboviken, still about a 3 km road walk. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken before planning access.

facilities.name: Tyckenhed high point and steep first climb
facilities.description: Eskilstuna municipality high point, about 113.9 m. Expect a sustained early climb from Svalboviken; official text says the hill burned in 1947.

facilities.name: Spring south of Svalboviken
facilities.description: Official spring about 2-2.5 km south of Svalboviken. Quality is explicitly uncertain despite OSM drinking-water tagging; treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Kolarkoja basic hut
facilities.description: Basic charcoal hut about 2 km after Tyckenhed, with two sleeping slabs/places and a door. Reports mention fireplace/benches outside, but still treat as simple first-come shelter with no toilet, bin, or guaranteed firewood.

facilities.name: Tryningen / Trynningen rest and natural water
facilities.description: Rest context by Tryningen/Trynningen. Lake water is natural/untested; reeds and vegetation can make access awkward, though reports mention a rocky rest/swim point and good tent possibilities nearby.

facilities.name: Tryningen reported fireplace/rest context
facilities.description: Secondary reports mention fireplace/bench context near Tryningen, but no official maintained fireplace was verified. Use only if a safe established fireplace is present and current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Stage 24 forestry, marking, and overgrowth warning
facilities.description: June 2025 comment reports clear-cuts, young growth, bark-beetle damage, overgrown/narrow trail, obscured markings after forestry work, confusing orange forestry paint, mud, and wild-boar-tracked ground despite no formal official fault report.

facilities.name: Kokärret nearby reserve caveat
facilities.description: Nearby wetland reserve/Natura 2000 area with no visitor facilities, trails or parking. Very wet unstable ground; do not use it as a shortcut, campsite, water/service stop, or access assumption.

facilities.name: Gruvtorpet open hut
facilities.description: Open overnight hut in a former outbuilding. Official lodging text lists four sleeping places; third-party shelter sources report up to six and field reports call it functional/basic, so plan for the lower capacity.

facilities.name: Gruvtorpet mining remains
facilities.description: Historic mining/torp context around Gruvtorpet and the late-stage forest. Look but do not disturb cultural remains.

facilities.name: Lundsjön pasture and cattle warning
facilities.description: Official text notes cattle may graze near Lundsjön and that the road can be used to go around the pasture. Keep distance and control dogs.

facilities.name: Lundsjön stage end
facilities.description: Stage 24 end and stage 25 start. No toilet, shop, or potable tap was verified at the endpoint.

facilities.name: Lundsjön nearby parking, approximate
facilities.description: Approximate parking context. Stage 24 says parking is about 250 m north in a former gravel pit, while stage 25 mentions possible parking about 100 m southwest by forest road; exact mapped lot and capacity were not verified.

facilities.name: Norra Vinstugan off-route lodging
facilities.description: Book-ahead timber-cabin lodging listed by Sörmlandsleden for Stage 24, about 650 m from the trail and 4-5 km north of Lundsjön; private/opening-dependent service with WC/shower/kitchenette context.

facilities.name: Ramsta rural bus context
facilities.description: Wider-area bus stop about 3 km east of Lundsjön, not a trailhead stop. Verify current Sörmlandstrafiken service before planning a road walk.

facilities.name: Bie rural bus/service context
facilities.description: Wider-area bus/service village more than 3 km west of Lundsjön. Useful only with a substantial road walk and current timetable verification; do not treat as on-stage resupply.

facilities.name: Magdakullan off-route seasonal services
facilities.description: Far off-route farm shop/cafe/restaurant/lodging/InfoPoint context north-west of the stage area, roughly 6 km from the route. Seasonal and opening-hour dependent; not an on-route resupply.
